title: Service lifecycle is not terminal lifecycle
summary: Persistent multi-client hosting has its own listener, worker, protocol and drain lifecycle. Graceful service shutdown stops admission, lets accepted workers finish and quiesces protocol capabilities while deliberately leaving the retained terminal/broker open.
invariants: Service drain is not IBM i signoff.
Operational health is detached scalar evidence, not a live authority handle.
HEALTHY requires lifecycle, listener, acceptor, endpoint and broker state to agree; disagreement is DEGRADED and fails closed.
Ordinary clients cannot convert service administration into terminal close/signoff authority.

provenance.claim: Supports this Terminal Machine/TN5250 continuity article.
